tools.name: workspace_search
tools.description: Search Google Drive, Gmail and Calendar with one query and get a merged, date-sorted result list. Use it for 'find everything about X' questions before falling back to per-service tools.

sources.description: Comma-separated sources to search: drive, gmail, calendar

calendar_days_back.description: Calendar only: how far back to search

calendar_days_ahead.description: Calendar only: how far ahead to search

tools.name: drive_search_advanced
tools.description: Advanced Google Drive search with full query syntax

tools.name: drive_list_permissions
tools.description: List permissions for a Drive file

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder in Google Drive

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move a file to a different folder

tools.name: drive_copy_file
tools.description: Copy a Drive file to a new file

tools.name: share_file
tools.description: Share a file with a user or make it public. REQUIRES allow_public=True to share publicly!

allow_public.description: MUST be true to share with type='anyone'. Security check.

tools.name: drive_revoke_public
tools.description: Revoke public access (type=anyone) for a Drive file. Requires confirm=True.

tools.name: drive_upload
tools.description: Upload a local file to Google Drive. Use convert_to to turn a docx/xlsx into a native Google Doc or Sheet.

local_path.description: Path on the machine running this server

name.description: Drive file name (default: the local file name)

parent_id.description: Destination folder ID (default: My Drive root)

convert_to.description: Convert to a native Google file on upload

tools.name: drive_export
tools.description: Export a Google Doc or Sheet to a local file: pdf, docx, xlsx, csv, txt and more.

format.description: pdf | docx | xlsx | csv | txt | md | html | …

tools.name: read_sheet
tools.description: Read data from a Google Sheet

tools.name: get_spreadsheet_meta
tools.description: Get metadata (sheets, titles) of a spreadsheet

tools.name: sheet_export_csv
tools.description: Export a range as CSV text

tools.name: create_spreadsheet
tools.description: Create a new Google Spreadsheet

tools.name: add_sheet
tools.description: Add a new sheet (tab) to a spreadsheet

tools.name: append_row
tools.description: Append a row to a Google Sheet

tools.name: update_sheet
tools.description: Update data in a Google Sheet. 'values' must be a list of lists of strings (rows of columns).

tools.name: clear_range
tools.description: Clear values in a spreadsheet range. Auto dry-run for large ranges (>100 cells).

confirm.description: Must be true to clear large ranges (>100 cells)

tools.name: sheet_find_replace
tools.description: Find/replace in a range with dry-run preview

tools.name: sheet_create_filter_view
tools.description: Create a filter view for a sheet with grid range

tools.name: sheet_create_named_range
tools.description: Create a named range using grid indexes

tools.name: sheet_format
tools.description: Format a Google Sheets range or sheet: bold/italic/size, number format, colours, alignment, wrap, column width, row height and frozen panes — all in one call.

sheet_name.description: Sheet tab name (default: first sheet or the one in range)

range.description: A1 range, e.g. A1:C10, A:C or 1:10 (default: whole sheet)

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read the content of a Google Doc

tools.name: create_doc
tools.description: Create a new Google Doc

tools.name: append_to_doc
tools.description: Append text to a Google Doc

tools.name: create_script_project
tools.description: Create a new Google Apps Script project

tools.name: get_script_content
tools.description: Get the content of a Google Apps Script project

tools.name: prepare_script_update
tools.description: STEP 1: Prepare a Google Apps Script update with automatic backup. Returns operation_id.

tools.name: execute_operation
tools.description: STEP 2: Execute a prepared operation by operation_id (from prepare_script_update)

tools.name: cancel_operation
tools.description: Cancel a prepared operation before execution

tools.name: restore_script_backup
tools.description: Restore a script from a backup file

backup_path.description: Full path to the backup JSON file

tools.name: script_run_function
tools.description: Run a function from an Apps Script project deployed as an API executable. Executes arbitrary code with your account's authority.

parameters.description: Positional arguments passed to the function

dev_mode.description: Run the latest saved code instead of the deployed version

tools.name: calendar_update_event
tools.description: Update an existing event. Only the fields you pass are changed; send_updates controls attendee notifications.

tools.name: calendar_delete_event
tools.description: Delete an event. Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: calendar_respond_to_invite
tools.description: Answer an invitation: accepted, declined or tentative. Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: digest
tools.description: Composite: one digest across Gmail, Calendar and Drive for the last N hours. Returns text by default, or creates a Google Doc.

sources.description: Comma-separated subset of gmail, calendar, drive

tools.name: compare_tables
tools.description: Composite: diff two ranges by a key column (added / removed / changed rows). Works across sheets or spreadsheets.

tools.name: get_gmail_profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated Gmail address for the current OAuth token

tools.name: list_emails
tools.description: List emails from Gmail

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read a specific email by ID

tools.name: gmail_search_and_summarize
tools.description: Search Gmail and return a brief summary

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a draft email in Gmail

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email via Gmail. Defaults to draft_mode=True for safety!

draft_mode.description: If true (default), creates draft instead of sending. Set to false to actually send.

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Send an existing draft email by draft ID

draft_id.description: The ID of the draft to send

tools.name: delete_email
tools.description: Move one email to Trash by ID (recoverable 30 days). REQUIRES confirm=True.

message_id.description: The ID of the email to delete

confirm.description: MUST be true to actually delete the email. Safety check.

tools.name: gmail_archive
tools.description: Archive a Gmail message (remove INBOX). Requires confirm=True.

tools.name: gmail_label_apply
tools.description: Apply a label to messages with dry-run preview

tools.name: gmail_get_thread
tools.description: Read a whole Gmail conversation: every message with date, sender, labels and attachments. Pass thread_id or any message_id.

tools.name: gmail_get_attachment
tools.description: Save an attachment from a Gmail message to disk. Select it by filename or attachment_id; with a single attachment both are optional.

tools.name: gmail_reply
tools.description: Reply inside the original thread with correct In-Reply-To/References headers. Creates a draft by default; set draft_mode=false to send.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List upcoming calendar events

tools.name: calendar_create_meeting
tools.description: Create a calendar meeting with attendees. Requires confirm=True.

tools.name: drive_get_metadata
tools.description: Read file metadata: name, type, size, owner, parents, created and modified time, sharing state and link.

tools.name: drive_rename_file
tools.description: Rename a Drive file without moving or copying it.

tools.name: drive_delete_file
tools.description: Move a file to the trash. Requires confirm=true; the file stays recoverable for 30 days. Permanent deletion is not exposed.

tools.name: drive_restore_file
tools.description: Restore a file from the Drive trash (trashed=false).

tools.name: drive_remove_permission
tools.description: Remove one permission from a file (revoke a person, group or public link). Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: doc_replace_text
tools.description: Find and replace text in a Google Doc. Without confirm=true it returns a preview with the number of occurrences.

tools.name: sheet_conditional_format
tools.description: Add a conditional formatting rule to a range: colour cells when the condition matches (text, number or emptiness).

condition.description: TEXT_CONTAINS, TEXT_EQ, NUMBER_GREATER, NUMBER_LESS, NUMBER_BETWEEN, IS_EMPTY, IS_NOT_EMPTY, …

tools.name: sheet_add_chart
tools.description: Insert a chart from a range: COLUMN, BAR, LINE, AREA, SCATTER, COMBO, STEPPED_AREA or PIE. The first column is the domain.

tools.name: sheet_delete_sheet
tools.description: Delete a sheet (tab) and everything on it. Requires confirm=true; the last remaining sheet cannot be deleted.

tools.name: sheet_insert_rows
tools.description: Insert empty rows before a 1-based row number.

tools.name: sheet_delete_rows
tools.description: Delete rows starting at a 1-based row number. Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: sheet_merge_cells
tools.description: Merge a range (MERGE_ALL, MERGE_ROWS, MERGE_COLUMNS) or unmerge it.

tools.name: gmail_list_labels
tools.description: List Gmail labels with their IDs, split into user and system labels.

tools.name: gmail_create_label
tools.description: Create a Gmail label (a duplicate name is rejected by Gmail).

tools.name: sheet_insert_columns
tools.description: Insert empty columns before a 1-based column number.

tools.name: sheet_delete_columns
tools.description: Delete columns starting at a 1-based column. Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: sheet_sort_range
tools.description: Sort a range by a 1-based column inside that range, ascending or descending. The header row is sorted with the data unless excluded from the range.

tools.name: docs_insert_image
tools.description: Insert an inline image from a public URL at the end of a document; width/height are in points.

tools.name: calendar_list_calendars
tools.description: List calendars available to the account with access roles.

tools.name: gmail_send_with_attachments
tools.description: Send or draft an email with local file attachments (20 MB total). Draft by default.

attachments.description: Local paths on the server machine

tools.name: script_list_deployments
tools.description: List deployments of an Apps Script project.

tools.name: sheet_add_pivot_table
tools.description: Create a pivot table on a new sheet from a source range. Columns are 1-based positions inside that range.

tools.name: docs_format_text
tools.description: Style every occurrence of a text: bold, italic, font size and/or heading. Without confirm returns a preview.

tools.name: gmail_list_drafts
tools.description: List Gmail drafts with recipient and subject.

tools.name: gmail_delete_draft
tools.description: Delete a draft. Requires confirm=true; nothing is sent.

tools.name: calendar_move_event
tools.description: Move an event to another calendar.

tools.name: script_create_deployment
tools.description: Create an Apps Script deployment from a saved version (latest when version_number is omitted).

tools.name: sheet_set_data_validation
tools.description: Add a data validation rule to a range: one of a list of values, or a number between two bounds.

tools.name: sheet_protect_range
tools.description: Protect a range: warning-only by default, or locked for everyone except the listed editors.

tools.name: sheet_set_borders
tools.description: Draw borders around and inside a range: SOLID, DOTTED, DASHED, SOLID_MEDIUM, SOLID_THICK or NONE.

tools.name: gmail_list_filters
tools.description: List Gmail filters with their criteria and actions.

tools.name: gmail_create_filter
tools.description: Create a Gmail filter: match from/subject/query, then add or remove labels (use label IDs).

tools.name: gmail_update_draft
tools.description: Replace the content of an existing draft.

tools.name: calendar_set_event_color
tools.description: Set an event colour by Google Calendar colour id ("1"–"11").

tools.name: script_update_deployment
tools.description: Point an Apps Script deployment at a newer version.

tools.name: bulk_plan
tools.description: Resolve a Drive, Gmail, Docs or Sheets selector into a reviewed plan (dry run). Returns a plan_id, matched count, total size, a small sample and warnings. Cap: 300 items by default; allow_large raises it to the hard limit. Nothing is changed until bulk_run is called with confirm=true.

tools.name: bulk_run
tools.description: Execute a reviewed bulk plan as a background job. Requires confirm=true and a non-expired plan_id. Pass job_id to resume an interrupted job. Returns immediately with a job_id; poll bulk_status for progress.

tools.name: bulk_status
tools.description: Compact progress for a bulk job: state, done/total, ok, skipped, failed percentages and the result file path.

tools.name: bulk_cancel
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running bulk job. In-flight items finish; the job state becomes cancelled and can be resumed later.

tools.name: bulk_result
tools.description: Read one page of per-item bulk results (id, name, status, error). Paginated: 50 items by default, 200 maximum. Use the result_file path for the full artifact.

tools.name: bulk_list
tools.description: List recent bulk jobs in this profile, newest first.

tools.name: bulk_undo
tools.description: Revert a completed bulk job using the state saved in its results. Supports Drive move (restore previous parents), rename (restore previous names) and trash (restore from trash). Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: tasks_list_lists
tools.description: List Google Tasks task lists with their ids.

tools.name: tasks_list
tools.description: List tasks in a Google Tasks list. Default list is '@default'; show_completed includes finished tasks.

tools.name: tasks_create
tools.description: Create a Google Task. due is an RFC 3339 timestamp (for example 2026-11-20T00:00:00.000Z).

tools.name: tasks_complete
tools.description: Mark a Google Task as completed.

tools.name: forms_create
tools.description: Create a Google Form with a title and optional description.

tools.name: forms_add_questions
tools.description: Append short-answer questions to a Google Form. Each question is an object with title, optional description and required.

tools.name: forms_get
tools.description: Read a Google Form: title, description, responder link and questions.

tools.name: forms_list_responses
tools.description: List Google Form responses with answers mapped to question titles.

tools.name: postmaster_list_domains
tools.description: List domains verified in Gmail Postmaster Tools with the account's permission level.

tools.name: postmaster_traffic_stats
tools.description: Read Gmail Postmaster traffic stats for a verified domain: spam rate, domain reputation, DKIM/DMARC/SPF ratios and delivery errors.

prompts.name: summarize_inbox
prompts.description: Fetch recent Gmail messages and prepare them for AI summarization. Optionally filter by a Gmail search query.

arguments.name: max_results
arguments.description: Maximum number of emails to include (default: 20)

prompts.name: analyze_spreadsheet
prompts.description: Read a Google Sheet range and prepare the data for AI analysis or visualization.

prompts.name: plan_week
prompts.description: Fetch upcoming calendar events and prepare a weekly planning summary for AI-assisted scheduling.

arguments.name: days_ahead
arguments.description: Number of days to look ahead (default: 7)

prompts.name: search_drive
prompts.description: Search Google Drive for files and prepare a structured list for AI review or organisation suggestions.

prompts.name: weekly_review
prompts.description: Cross-source review of the last N days: mail, changed files and the coming agenda, prepared for a weekly summary.

arguments.name: days_back
arguments.description: How many days to look back (default: 7)

prompts.name: inbox_triage
prompts.description: Fetch a Gmail slice and prepare it for triage: urgent, waiting, informational, archive candidates.

prompts.name: compare_brief
prompts.description: Diff two ranges by a key column and prepare a reconciliation report.
